architectural_decisions.path_b_vs_path_a: Path B chosen for protocol fit — proactive turn rides established AG-UI rail. Path A (REST + FE injection) is documented as fallback if M1 recon shows the FE has no programmatic AG-UI trigger API.
architectural_decisions.meaningful_event_allowlist: Hardcoded server-side frozenset({sim_run, step_advance, measurement_commit}) per design-doc recommendation. Promote to per-skill config only if a skill needs different rules.
architectural_decisions.auto_greet_counts_toward_cap: Yes per design-doc recommendation. M4 has the /greet endpoint increment the same counter so the effective cap of 2 means 1 reactive after the greet for a proactive_max_per_session=2 session.
architectural_decisions.cooldown_granularity: Session-wide per design-doc + brief. 90s between any two proactive turns.
architectural_decisions.phase_a_refactor: Filed as M10 follow-up doc, not in this sprint. Land Phase B first, exercise it for a few pilot sessions, then refactor Phase A onto the same Path B rails for protocol consistency.

parallelisation_notes: Single-track sequential. Last sprint's parallel sub-agent shape was right for two file-disjoint quick wins; this fullstack sprint where each milestone informs the next is better sequential.
